details: The agent faithfully executed the proposed analysis. They created the Python entry script per plan, built a Docker image with the specified packages, and ran the analysis computing a Spearman correlation between MiniK_Total and DSM5_Total with a one-sided (less) p-value. Both Task1 and Task2 were completed using the same method and variables, with listwise deletion for missing data, and outputs included rho, one-sided and two-sided p-values, N, and clear result text. The produced results (rho = -0.5896, one-sided p = 1.383e-14, N = 138) are consistent across stdout and saved JSON artifacts (data/results_ph39a.json and data/execution_result.json). No major deviations from analysis_info.json were observed.
